title: Speculative Decoding in vLLM on AMD GPUs
summary: This article explains how vLLM implements speculative decoding on AMD GPUs using ROCm, enabling faster LLM inference by having a smaller draft model propose tokens that are verified in parallel by the larger target model, making AMD hardware more competitive for production LLM deployments.
problem_solved: Enables efficient speculative decoding inference on AMD GPUs, which previously lacked optimized support in vLLM's high-performance inference engine.
why_valuable: Allows AMD GPU users to achieve significantly faster LLM inference speeds at lower hardware costs, democratizing access to optimized large language model serving.
